title: Branch Manager – Coworking Operations
description:
**Job Title: Branch Manager – Coworking Operations**

**Company:** Betaspace Coworking  
**Location:** Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu  
**Job Type:** Full-time, on-site  
**Experience:** 5+ years, including branch or facility management  
**Reporting to:** Operations Head / Management  
Contact Number : 0091 9500 8187 02

**About Betaspace**

Betaspace provides managed offices, private offices, coworking desks, meeting rooms, and virtual office services. We focus on delivering well-maintained workspaces, reliable facilities, and responsive client service.

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced Branch Manager to take ownership of a Betaspace branch’s operations, team performance, client experience, occupancy, and collections follow-up.

You will lead the branch team, maintain service standards, resolve operational issues, control approved expenses, and support business growth through effective enquiry handling, client retention, and renewals.

This is an active leadership role requiring regular branch inspections, direct team supervision, sound judgement, and accountability for results.

**Key Roles and Responsibilities**

**1. Branch Ownership and Operational Management**

* Take overall responsibility for the assigned branch’s daily operations and performance.
* Ensure the branch is clean, organised, fully functional, and ready for clients.
* Conduct regular walkthroughs and review opening, operating, and closing checks.
* Establish clear work priorities, assign responsibilities, and verify completion.
* Anticipate operational needs and address gaps before they affect clients.
* Implement company policies and approved operating procedures consistently.

**2. Team Leadership and Performance**

* Lead admin executives, housekeeping, security, and other assigned support staff.
* Set clear expectations, allocate work, and monitor service quality.
* Plan attendance coverage, shifts, leave arrangements, and staff handovers.
* Review daily reports and verify that reported work has been completed.
* Coach team members and conduct regular performance discussions.
* Address performance gaps and recommend training, staffing, or corrective action to management.
* Support recruitment and onboarding of branch employees.

**3. Housekeeping and Workspace Standards**

* Maintain consistent standards across reception, cabins, workstations, meeting rooms, pantry, washrooms, and common areas.
* Oversee daily cleaning schedules, periodic deep cleaning, and inspection checklists.
* Ensure cleaning gaps are corrected and recurring issues are addressed.
* Monitor workspace appearance, furniture condition, signage, and overall ambience.
* Ensure available spaces are maintained to the same standard as occupied areas.

**4. Client Relationships and Service Standards**

* Build professional relationships with client representatives and key contacts.
* Take ownership of escalated complaints and coordinate timely resolution.
* Track client concerns, commitments, and service requests through completion.
* Conduct periodic feedback discussions to understand satisfaction and changing requirements.
* Coordinate approved workspace changes and additional service requests.
* Identify dissatisfaction or potential exits early and develop retention actions with management.

**5. Occupancy, Enquiries, and Business Growth**

* Maintain accurate occupancy and availability records for seats, cabins, and offices.
* Oversee enquiry response, branch tours, proposals, and prospective client follow-ups.
* Coordinate with sales and management to convert suitable enquiries into bookings.
* Monitor upcoming vacancies, move-ins, expansions, and move-outs.
* Identify opportunities for additional seats, meeting room use, and other relevant services.
* Work towards occupancy and revenue targets agreed with management.
* Offer pricing, discounts, or commercial commitments only within approved authority.

**6. Collections Follow-up and Renewals**

* Review outstanding payments with the accounts team and assign follow-up actions.
* Ensure invoices and payment reminders reach the appropriate client contacts.
* Track payment commitments and escalate overdue or disputed amounts promptly.
* Coordinate clarification of billing concerns with accounts and management.
* Plan renewal discussions before agreements expire.
* Maintain visibility of renewal status, potential exits, and revenue risks.
* Implement access-related actions only through approved company procedures.

**7. Facilities and Preventive Maintenance**

* Oversee the operational readiness of internet, Wi-Fi, AC, lighting, drinking water, washrooms, access systems, and other facilities.
* Coordinate UPS, generator, CCTV, electrical, and other technical servicing with authorised personnel.
* Maintain preventive maintenance schedules, service records, and applicable AMC details.
* Plan maintenance activities to minimise disruption to clients.
* Monitor breakdowns, response times, recurring faults, and repair completion.
* Escalate infrastructure risks with practical recommendations and cost estimates.

**8. Vendor and Building Coordination**

* Manage branch-level coordination with technicians, suppliers, service providers, and building representatives.
* Obtain and evaluate quotations based on cost, quality, and service requirements.
* Seek approvals before confirming purchases or work beyond delegated limits.
* Monitor vendor attendance, timelines, work quality, and completion.
* Verify supporting bills and work completion before recommending payment.
* Coordinate building-related matters such as shared facilities, parking, access, and maintenance.

**9. Client Onboarding, Bookings, and Exits**

* Oversee workspace preparation and smooth onboarding of new clients.
* Ensure documentation, access cards, keys, and handover records are coordinated.
* Review meeting room bookings, day passes, and workspace allocations.
* Ensure client commitments are communicated clearly to the branch team.
* Supervise exit inspections, asset checks, access returns, and handovers.
* Coordinate financial closure with accounts and management.

**10. Expense Control, Procurement, and Inventory**

* Monitor branch operating expenses against approved budgets.
* Review purchase requests, stock requirements, and petty cash records.
* Ensure expenses have appropriate approvals and supporting documents.
* Maintain accountability for furniture, equipment, keys, access cards, and consumables.
* Prevent avoidable wastage, stock shortages, and unnecessary expenditure.
* Recommend cost improvements while maintaining service standards.

**11. Safety, Security, and Incident Management**

* Oversee visitor management, access control, and security coordination.
* Ensure emergency contacts are available and exits remain unobstructed.
* Report hazards, damage, security concerns, and significant incidents immediately.
* Coordinate incident response according to company procedures.
* Maintain incident records and follow up on corrective actions.
* Ensure staff understand their responsibilities during emergencies.

**12. Reporting and Branch Performance Review**

* Submit a daily branch summary covering completed work, client issues, maintenance, enquiries, collections follow-up, and pending actions.
* Review staff reports for accuracy and completeness.
* Maintain an action tracker with responsible persons and target completion dates.
* Share weekly or monthly performance updates as required by management.
* Highlight occupancy, renewals, overdue payments, expenses, service gaps, and staffing requirements.
* Present issues with clear facts, proposed solutions, and approvals required.
* Implement approved improvements and track their effectiveness.

**Qualifications and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline; qualifications in business administration, hospitality, or facilities management are an advantage.
* Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in coworking operations, business centres, facilities management, hospitality, serviced offices, or a similar environment.
* Experience independently managing a branch, office, property, or facility.
* Demonstrated experience leading teams and handling client escalations.
* Experience in vendor management, expense monitoring, occupancy support, renewals, and collections follow-up.

**Required Skills**

* Strong leadership, delegation, and team supervision.
* Professional communication in Tamil and English.
* Excellent client relationship and complaint-resolution skills.
* Ability to prioritise competing operational and commercial requirements.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, email, and performance reporting.
* Good judgement in handling expenses, vendors, and client commitments.
* Consistent follow-through and accountability for branch results.
* Ability to identify risks early and escalate with recommended solutions.
* Willingness to inspect the branch regularly and supervise operations directly.

**Key Performance Measures**

Performance will be reviewed against targets agreed with management, including:

* Branch cleanliness, readiness, and service standards.
* Client satisfaction, complaint resolution, and retention.
* Occupancy, enquiry follow-ups, and booking conversions.
* Renewal completion and timely collections follow-up.
* Staff attendance coverage, productivity, and work quality.
* Maintenance completion and control of recurring faults.
* Expense control and accuracy of branch records.
* Timely reporting and completion of pending actions.

**Work Arrangement**

This is a full-time, on-site position at an assigned Betaspace branch in Coimbatore. Salary will be based on experience and demonstrated capability. Working hours, weekly off, and benefits will be discussed during the recruitment process.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)

Education:

* Master's (Required)

Language:

* English (Required)

Location:

* Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

* Track enquiries and ensure timely follow-ups.

title: Regional Facilities Manager
description:
**Department:** Facilities Management / Administration  
**Designation:** Regional Facility Manager  
**Location:** Tamil Nadu Region  
**Reporting To:** Head – Facilities / National Facility Manager  
**Experience:** 8–12 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

1. Job Purpose

To oversee and manage end-to-end facility management operations across multiple locations in the Tamil Nadu region, ensuring operational efficiency, statutory compliance, cost optimization, service quality, infrastructure upkeep, and customer satisfaction.

The Regional Facility Manager will be responsible for leading facility teams, managing service partners, implementing operational standards, and ensuring safe, reliable, and efficient facility operations across all assigned locations.

2. Key Roles and Responsibilities

**A. Regional Facility Operations**

* Manage day-to-day facility management operations across all assigned locations in Tamil Nadu.
* Ensure effective management of housekeeping, security, technical maintenance, landscaping, pest control, and other facility services.
* Conduct regular site inspections and operational audits.
* Ensure facilities are maintained in accordance with organizational standards and SLAs.
* Develop and implement standard operating procedures (SOPs).

**B. Engineering and Maintenance**

* Oversee preventive and corrective maintenance of electrical, HVAC, plumbing, DG sets, lifts, fire safety systems, and other infrastructure.
* Ensure uninterrupted operation of critical equipment and utilities.
* Monitor equipment performance and maintenance schedules.
* Coordinate breakdown maintenance and ensure timely resolution of technical issues.
* Maintain asset registers and equipment maintenance records.

**C. Vendor and Contract Management**

* Manage facility management vendors and service providers across the region.
* Monitor vendor performance against agreed SLAs and KPIs.
* Conduct periodic vendor reviews and performance assessments.
* Ensure proper deployment of manpower and adherence to contractual obligations.
* Identify opportunities for vendor consolidation and cost optimization.

**D. Budgeting and Cost Control**

* Prepare and manage regional facility management budgets.
* Monitor monthly operating expenses and utility consumption.
* Implement cost-saving initiatives without compromising service quality.
* Review vendor invoices and validate service delivery.
* Track budget versus actual expenditure.

**E. Statutory Compliance and Safety**

* Ensure compliance with applicable statutory requirements, including:
* Fire and life safety regulations.
* Electrical safety requirements.
* Lift and DG-related statutory requirements.
* Building and local authority approvals.
* Applicable labour laws and contractor compliance.
* Environmental and waste management regulations.
* Coordinate statutory inspections, renewals, and audits.
* Ensure implementation of EHS policies and emergency response procedures.
* Conduct fire drills and safety awareness programmes.

**F. Team Management**

* Lead and supervise facility managers, engineers, supervisors, and outsourced manpower.
* Define responsibilities and performance expectations.
* Conduct periodic performance reviews and training programmes.
* Build a service-oriented and accountable regional facility team.
* Ensure adequate manpower deployment across all locations.

**G. MIS and Reporting**

* Prepare and submit monthly regional facility performance reports.
* Track KPIs, including:
* Facility operational uptime.
* Maintenance closure and response time.
* Housekeeping and security performance.
* Utility consumption and cost.
* Vendor SLA compliance.
* Statutory compliance status.
* Customer satisfaction.
* Present operational updates and improvement plans to senior management.

3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Achievement of regional facility operational targets.
* Compliance with approved budgets and cost-saving targets.
* Preventive maintenance schedule compliance.
* Reduction in equipment breakdowns and downtime.
* Vendor SLA and KPI performance.
* Statutory and safety compliance.
* Customer and internal stakeholder satisfaction.
* Timely closure of facility-related complaints.
* Successful completion of facility audits.
* Manpower productivity and operational efficiency.

4. Educational Qualification

* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical / Electrical / Civil Engineering.
* Diploma in Engineering with relevant extensive experience may also be considered.
* Additional certification in Facility Management, Project Management, or Safety Management will be an advantage.

5. Experience and Skills

* 8–12 years of experience in Facility Management / Administration / Engineering Operations.
* Minimum 3–5 years of experience in managing multiple facilities or regional operations.
* Experience in managing large-scale commercial, corporate, industrial, or institutional facilities.
* Strong knowledge of MEP systems, HVAC, electrical infrastructure, fire safety, and building maintenance.
* Experience in vendor management, budgeting, contract management, and statutory compliance.
* Strong leadership, communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, MIS reporting, and CAFM / CMMS systems.

6. Regional Coverage

Responsible for managing facilities across assigned locations in Tamil Nadu, including:

* Chennai
* Coimbatore
* Madurai
* Trichy
* Salem
* Tirunelveli
* Erode
* Vellore
* Hosur
* Other assigned locations in Tamil Nadu.

7. Key Competencies

* Strategic and operational leadership.
* Multi-location facility management.
* Cost control and financial management.
* Vendor and stakeholder management.
* Technical and engineering expertise.
* Statutory compliance and risk management.
* Team building and people management.
* Customer service orientation.
* Decision-making and crisis management.

**Overall Accountability:** Ensure seamless facility operations across the Tamil Nadu region through effective people management, vendor governance, infrastructure maintenance, statutory compliance, and continuous improvement while achieving organizational service quality and financial objectives.

Pay: From ₹50,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Internet reimbursement
* Leave encashment
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

Role Purpose

The NCD Manager will be responsible for managing the Company's day-to-day Non-Convertible Debenture (NCD) operations, investor servicing, documentation, interest payouts, maturity repayments, reconciliation and regulatory compliance.

In addition to operational responsibilities, the candidate will support **NCD fundraising, investor acquisition and mobilisation of funds** to achieve the Company's fundraising objectives.

A hands-on financial services professional capable of independently managing NCD operations, maintaining investor relationships, ensuring timely payouts and compliance, and supporting fundraising activities.

Experience

* 5+ years of experience in NBFC / Banking / Financial Services preferred.

* Strong exposure to financial operations, investor servicing and documentation.

Key ResponsibilitiesNCD Operations

* Manage end-to-end NCD operations, including investor onboarding, subscriptions, application processing and allotments.

Hotel Mahi’s Gateway, a 39-room hotel with Shooters Bar, is looking for an experienced, hands-on Operations Manager to oversee daily operations and strengthen service standards, staff discipline and accountability.

We need someone who takes ownership, leads by example and follows through until issues are resolved. The role reports directly to management and requires an active presence across departments.  
Key Responsibilities

**Daily Operations and Guest Service**

* Oversee front office, housekeeping, maintenance, security and bar operations.
* Ensure rooms are clean, properly maintained and ready before guest arrival.
* Monitor reservations, check-ins, check-outs, room allocation and shift handovers.
* Handle guest complaints professionally and ensure timely resolution.
* Coordinate guest breakfast and room-service arrangements with the food provider.

**Staff Management and Discipline**

* Plan duty rosters, weekly offs and leave coverage to maintain adequate staffing.
* Monitor attendance, grooming, punctuality and work performance.
* Conduct daily briefings and assign clear responsibilities to each department.
* Train staff, implement practical SOPs and follow up on compliance.
* Support recruitment, onboarding and performance reviews.

**Cash, Billing and Operational Controls**

* Verify that every reservation, occupied room, guest charge and payment is correctly recorded in the PMS.
* Cross-check PMS room status against housekeeping’s physical room-status report.
* Review daily collections and shift handovers with reception and accounts; investigate and report discrepancies promptly.
* Ensure discounts, refunds, cancellations, complimentary stays and credit arrangements follow management approval procedures.
* Maintain individual staff accountability and accurate supporting records.

**Stock, Maintenance and Cost Control**

* Monitor bar stock, linen, housekeeping supplies and operating consumables.
* Coordinate stock checks with stores and accounts, and investigate shortages or unusual consumption.
* Verify purchase requirements and receipt of goods through the approved process.
* Follow up on maintenance complaints and preventive maintenance.
* Control wastage and unnecessary expenditure while maintaining service quality.

**Reporting and Follow-up**

* Submit a concise daily report covering occupancy, collections, pending payments, complaints, maintenance issues and staff concerns.
* Maintain an action list with responsible staff members and completion deadlines.
* Escalate serious incidents promptly and keep management informed.
* Work with reception and marketing to improve occupancy, guest satisfaction and repeat business.

Candidate Requirements

* Minimum **5 years of hotel operations experience**, including at least **2 years in an Operations Manager, Assistant Operations Manager or comparable supervisory role**.
* Experience managing a similar-sized hotel; exposure to bar operations is an advantage.
* Strong working knowledge of front office, housekeeping, maintenance and daily cash controls.
* Comfortable using hotel PMS software, POS systems, Excel and operational reports. Experience with **Microgenn and Petpooja** is an advantage.
* Proven ability to lead teams, train staff and introduce consistent working procedures.
* Clear communication in **Tamil and English**; additional languages are an advantage.
* Diploma or degree in Hotel Management preferred. Candidates with strong relevant experience will also be considered.
* Willingness to work flexible shifts, weekends and public holidays according to operational requirements.

Who Will Succeed in This Role?

A trustworthy, organised and firm but fair manager who is comfortable working on the floor, addressing problems directly and maintaining clear records. You should be able to demonstrate improvements you have made in guest service, staff performance, cost control or operational accountability.

How to Apply

Apply through Indeed with your updated CV. Please include your **current location, relevant hotel experience, current and expected salary, and notice period**.

* Supervise service teams and ensure adequate manpower deployment across all facility areas.
* Monitor housekeeping standards, washroom cleanliness, common areas, cafeteria hygiene, and pantry services.

* Manage vendors, contractors, service-level agreements (SLAs), and key performance indicators (KPIs).

5. Team and Cost Management

* Manage manpower planning, shift scheduling, attendance, and productivity.
* Monitor operational budgets, consumables, inventory, and service costs.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, control costs, and enhance service delivery.

* Knowledge of preventive maintenance, SLA/KPI monitoring, facility audits, and operational reporting.

**Skills**
----------

Cable Management Cutting Tools Terminal Operations Production Planning Cycle time, Takt time, Line balancing, Cell capacity, man power balancing knowledge Quality and Reliability Engg Control Plans ISO SAP BOM management Cross Functional Collaborations

#### **Minimum Qualification**

Bachelor of Engineering (BE)

  

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Roles & Responsibilities :**

**Production Planning & Execution** – Plan and execute daily, weekly and monthly production as per customer demand and delivery requirements.

**End-to-End Process Management** – Manage complete harness manufacturing from wire cutting, stripping, crimping and terminal insertion to routing, taping, testing and packing.

**Capacity & Line Balancing** – Optimize manpower, machines and workstation allocation based on takt time, cycle time and production volume.

**Manpower Management** – Plan manpower deployment, shift allocation, absenteeism coverage and operator productivity.

**Skill Development** – Maintain skill matrix and drive operator training, certification, multi-skilling and periodic skill evaluation.

**Quality Control** – Ensure adherence to process controls and achieve Right First Time / Zero Defect production through in-process and final inspection.

**Crimping Process Control** – Ensure proper crimp height, pull-force, terminal application, tooling condition and periodic crimp validation.

**Electrical Testing Management** – Ensure continuity, short/open circuit, insulation resistance, Hi-Pot and functional testing requirements are effectively controlled.

**Material Management** – Ensure availability of wires, terminals, connectors, seals, sleeves, tapes and other materials with proper FIFO and traceability.

**Equipment & Tooling Management** – Ensure machine availability, preventive maintenance, calibration and readiness of cutting, stripping, crimping and testing equipment.

**NPI & Engineering Changes** – Support new product introduction, trial builds, process validation, ECN implementation and production ramp-up.

**Process Documentation** – Ensure effective implementation of BOM, SOP, WI, Control Plan, PFMEA, process parameters and inspection standards.

**Continuous Improvement** – Drive 5S, Kaizen, Poka-Yoke, Lean Manufacturing, waste reduction and productivity improvement initiatives.

**Cross-Functional Coordination** – Work closely with Quality, Engineering, SCM, Maintenance, Planning, NPI and Customer teams to resolve production issues.

**Performance & KPI Management** – Monitor and improve **Plan vs Actual, Productivity, OEE, FPY, PPM, Rejection, Rework, Downtime, Labor Efficiency and On-Time Delivery**.
